name: AAPL Historical Volatility Analysis
description: Comprehensive volatility analysis of Apple Inc. stock over the last 2 years, including multiple volatility metrics, rolling volatility charts, and distribution analysis.
source:
# AAPL Historical Volatility Analysis
# Comprehensive volatility analysis with multiple metrics and visualizations

# Data source - Daily OHLCV
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
open = src.o
high = src.h
low = src.l
close = src.c

# =============================================================================
# VOLATILITY CALCULATIONS
# =============================================================================

# Daily returns for distribution analysis
daily_returns = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(close)

# Standard annualized volatility at different periods
vol_14d = volatility(period=14)(close)
vol_20d = volatility(period=20)(close)
vol_30d = volatility(period=30)(close)
vol_60d = volatility(period=60)(close)

# Range-based volatility estimators (30-day period for comparison)
vol_gk = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.garman_klass, period=30)()
vol_yz = volatility_estimator(type=VolatilityEstimatorType.yang_zhang, period=30)()

# =============================================================================
# STATISTICAL METRICS
# =============================================================================

# Min and max volatility (using 30-day as reference)
vol_min = min(period=504)(vol_30d)
vol_max = max(period=504)(vol_30d)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CARDS
# =============================================================================

cards(
    layout=CardLayout(
        title="Volatility Overview",
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title="Current 14-Day Volatility", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Current 30-Day Volatility", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Average Volatility (2 Years)", card_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Min Volatility", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title="Max Volatility", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Summary"
)(vol_14d, vol_30d, vol_30d, vol_min, vol_max)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD TABLES
# =============================================================================

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title="Volatility Summary Statistics",
        row_size=3,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=["Last Value", "Mean", "Std Dev"],
        col_headers=["14-Day", "30-Day", "60-Day", "Garman-Klass", "Yang-Zhang"],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Std, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    category="Statistics"
)(vol_14d, vol_30d, vol_60d, vol_gk, vol_yz, vol_14d, vol_30d, vol_60d, vol_gk, vol_yz, vol_14d, vol_30d, vol_60d, vol_gk, vol_yz)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD CHARTS
# =============================================================================

# Rolling Volatility Comparison (20-day vs 60-day)
timeseries_lines(
    title="Rolling Volatility (20-day vs 60-day)",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="20-Day Volatility", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="60-Day Volatility", color=Color.Orange)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.20, title="20% Level", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(vol_20d, vol_60d)

# Volatility Estimators Comparison
timeseries_lines(
    title="Volatility Estimators Comparison",
    category="Charts",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Standard (Close-to-Close)", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Garman-Klass", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Yang-Zhang", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(vol_30d, vol_gk, vol_yz)

# Daily Returns Distribution
histogram(
    title="Daily Returns Distribution",
    category="Charts",
    bins=50,
    x_axis_label="Daily Return (%)",
    x_axis_format="PercentFormat",
    x_axis_dp=2
)(daily_returns)
